name: Savory Oatmeal with Avocado, Cilantro, Scallions & Sesame
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Add salt and broth to a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, stir in oats and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and let simmer for 3-5 minutes or until oats reach desired consistency.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out.
To serve, divide the oatmeal between bowls and top with avocado, green onions, and cilantro. Garnish with sesame oil, sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
